subject: ADR-236: a figure the clock carries is not carried -- audit_carried reads every page under two clocks, and a figure counts as carried only if both carry it
body: audit_carried matches each figure a page works out against every number in its exports, and exports carry their time: ADR-234's run read the releve's 49 taxa in pack as carried by a timestamp's 49 and flipped its declaration idle. Every page is now read twice, on the real clock and on one shifted by 405 days 7 h 23 m 31 s, so no field of a timestamp is the same under both; a figure is carried only if both readings carry it. The clock is shifted, not frozen, so durations still tick. verify_carried 47 to 55 with a fixture whose figure only its export's timestamp carries; mutate_carried 29 to 36. The kit reads exactly what it read before: 317 figures, none lost.
